Topic: Startups, products and business

Marketplaces earn their money when you browse, not when you buy. An AI assistant that shops for you skips the browsing.

Ad revenue vs operating income (2025):
- Amazon retail: 2x
- DoorDash: 1.9x
- Instacart: 2.2x
